steps.content: The wind is blowing so gusty on the stage, almost making you unstable. Fortunately, there's a small firewood room not far away, with a warm light on.
You walk into the room and find a girl crying.

steps.speaker: Sad Girl
steps.content: My wicked stepmother broke my right hand, and so did my dream of becoming a court painter.

steps.speaker: Sad Girl
steps.content: From today on, my hand can only be used to hold a rag, or to carry a broom... Ah!!
As the girl sings, her right hand can't help but tremble, accidentally knocking over the bucket of dirty water.
The girl cries in the dirty water.
Dreamy music starts to play, and ribbons of magical light, acting like a pair of hands, lift the girl from the dirty water.
If you have time to cry here and waste your time, you might as well do something meaningful.
The magical light ribbons continue to float. The dirty water turns into a palette, the pile of firewood turns into a drawing board... The firewood room disappears, replaced by a painting studio.
With the light dots, Lisa appears on the stage, her expression haughty.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Pick up your paintbrush and make art of your own.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Don't you still have your left hand?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Or are you saying that the knowledge you learned, the experience you accumulated, all turned into water in your brain, washed away with your useless tears?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Starting today, I will teach you how to paint with your left hand. However, if you can only paint garbage in the end... On the day of the court painter's exam, I won't provide you with a pumpkin carriage to the palace.
Lisa waves her magic wand. Several pieces of paper flutter from the sky and fall in front of the girl, one of them falls into your hand.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Start practicing. Don't expect an easy life as my student.

You look at the paper in your hand. It's more like a small note than a sketch paper. You can't make out any words or images on it. It seems like a small piece has been cut out from a complete pattern.
